name: bossform-monorepo
description: BOSSFORM (arena shmup) built on METRONOME (standalone deterministic lockstep engine).

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @bossform/game
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p engine/tsconfig.json && tsc -p game/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json && tsc -p cloudflare/tsconfig.json
scripts.cloudflare:pages:create: wrangler pages project create bossform --production-branch master
